content.short: College DAO is the largest and fastest-growing collective of student blockchain communities globally.
content.description: College DAO bridges higher education and the blockchain industry by empowering student-led educational projects, consulting engagements, and events that cultivate blockchain talent and open career pathways. As an innovation catalyst, it connects aspiring student founders with impactful startups from academia, providing practical support, mentorship, and resources to accelerate development. By aligning campus initiatives with real-world opportunities, College DAO helps students gain hands-on experience while advancing the broader ecosystem.
